title: Lando Calrissian
description: After his misspent youth as a smuggler, Lando Calrissian decided to try his hand as a gambler, which led him to the snowy climes of Vandor. A gifted cheat and charismatic swindler, Lando could sell ice on Hoth. When Han Solo and Qi'ra approached him to help with the Kessel Run and steal raw coaxium for Crimson Dawn, he reluctantly agreed, and it nearly cost him his ship.
